rationale:
`assets/skills/habeas-requirements/SKILL.md` is a bundled skill with `name:` front matter, so it is a site of `requirements.cli.skill_conventions.references`. That requirement lets a skill link to files for specialized material, and it requires each such link to say when to read the file.

The file has no Markdown links. It points to other files only by backticked path:
- `references/review-prompt.md` appears in workflow step 3. The step says when to read it: a review subagent reads it, together with the habeas skill's `SKILL.md`, when it is started for a requirement group. Step 3 also says to review against the prompt yourself if subagents can't be started.
- `references/fixme.md` of the habeas-evidence skill appears in the "Choosing references" section. The text says to use it "to defer a requirement gap the user agrees to", which states when to read it.

Neither reference is a link without a when-to-read condition, so no obligation is broken. The requirement has no violation queries.

text: A bundled skill MAY put material needed only in specialized situations in files it links to. Each such link MUST say when to read the file. Each bundled skill, recognized by its front matter, is a site:
